rules.sentence: Pulmonary hypertension diagnosis can be confirmed with right heart catheterization that measures the hemodynamic parameters accurately.
Pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) helps in determining the prognosis of pulmonary hypertension.
V/Q Scans are done to rule out chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH) once the common causes are excluded.
Mean PAP is high in both PAH and Group 2 PH, but PCWP greater than 15 mm Hg is typically seen in PH due to left heart disease.
